# Brian Ward Appraisal — ward.pro

> Brian Ward is a California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser (license AR036053) who has
> appraised California residential property since 2004. He prepares SPECIALTY appraisals: date-of-death
> valuations and the stepped-up basis that follows from them, estate and trust administration, gift tax
> reporting, private party and intra-family transactions, divorce and dissolution, bankruptcy,
> Proposition 19 transfers, property tax appeals, appraisal review, and expert witness testimony.
> These are valuations prepared for the IRS, the probate and family-law courts, attorneys, CPAs,
> trustees and fiduciaries. Lending and mortgage valuations are a separate product that lenders order
> through their own approved panels; they are not part of this practice.

## Key facts

- Appraiser: Brian Ward, California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser, license AR036053,
  issued by the California Bureau of Real Estate Appraisers.
- Appraising since 2004; thousands of completed assignments; qualified repeatedly as an expert
  witness in California Superior Court in family-law and bankruptcy matters.
- Phone: (619) 630-9273 · Email: contact@Ward.pro
- Office: 15877 Paseo Del Sur, San Diego, CA 92127
- Site: https://www.ward.pro/
- **Full-service appraisals, including in-person interior and exterior inspection: San Diego County
  and Riverside County only.**
- **Desktop and retrospective appraisals, prepared without a property visit: all 58 California
  counties.** This site publishes dedicated pages for 126 communities across 17 counties.
- Important limitation stated by the appraiser: for improved residential property a desktop appraisal
  does NOT satisfy IRS requirements; those assignments require a Standard appraisal. Vacant land is
  the exception.
- Reports are prepared under USPAP (Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice).
- Retrospective effective dates available from the recent past to more than forty years back.
- Sister sites, same appraiser: brianward.com (main company site), date-of-death.com (statewide
  date-of-death valuations for single-family homes and condominiums).

## Fee schedule (starting prices; exact fee confirmed before the client commits)

- GroundWork Report: $99 — Data, not a valuation &mdash; and it says so. You get the qualifying closed sales surrounding the home sorted into five distance tiers, each tier reporting its own middle sale price and price per square foot, the county record for the parcel, a year of trend charts, an interactive estimator, an unadjusted price band carrying no opinion of value, and a candid read on how strong the underlying data actually is. It arrives the next business day as a private web page that saves to PDF. Order an appraisal afterward and this fee comes off the top.
- Basic Desktop Appraisal: $299 — The complete comparable sales analysis, adjustments included, delivered in a condensed report. Written under USPAP. Revisions are covered. I never set foot on the property.
- Desktop Appraisal: $449 — A full narrative report: the property described in detail, maps placing it in its location and neighborhood, photographs of each comparable sale, an analysis of market conditions, and the parcel's transaction history. Still no site visit.
- Drive-By Appraisal: $649 — Takes the Desktop report and adds what I can document from the curb &mdash; exterior photographs I shot myself and first-hand observation of the surrounding street and neighborhood.
- Standard Appraisal: $699 — The Desktop report plus my walking through the house. I inspect inside and out, photograph both, and assess condition room by room. This is the tier that satisfies the IRS for improved residential property and the one I bring to court.
- 2–4 Unit Desktop Appraisal: $549 — Desktop treatment for a duplex, triplex or fourplex, built from public records and MLS data, with each unit analyzed rather than the building averaged.
- 2–4 Unit Standard Appraisal: $799 — The inspection-based report for two-to-four unit property. I walk every unit, not a representative one.

### Add-ons
- Square Footage Measurement: $35 per 1,500 sq ft — I measure the living area by laser and certify the figure. Attaches to any report tier.
- Rush Delivery: +30% — Moves your assignment up the queue when my calendar has room. I confirm it is actually possible before taking the surcharge.

A 5% discount applies to cash-equivalent payment (Zelle, check, cash). A reduced two-client fee
applies when both spouses jointly retain the appraiser in a dissolution matter. Expert-witness
testimony is quoted separately and billed by time.

## Services

- [Date of Death Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/date-of-death-appraisals): Retrospective date-of-death appraisals for probate, IRS Form 706 and stepped-up basis. Effective dates from last month to 40+ years back. Statewide California desktop coverage.
- [Estate & Trust Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/estate-trust-appraisals): Probate, trust funding and distribution appraisals for California estates. Current and retrospective values for executors, trustees, beneficiaries and estate counsel.
- [Private Party & Gift Tax Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/family-transaction-appraisals): Private party and gift tax appraisals in California: intra-family sales, sibling buyouts, transfers between private parties. Fair market value documentation for IRS Form 709.
- [Divorce Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/divorce-appraisals): Neutral divorce appraisals for California family-law matters. Current or date-of-separation values, two-client engagements, expert testimony.
- [Proposition 19 Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/prop-19-appraisals): Proposition 19 appraisals for California parent-to-child transfers and base-year value transfers. Establish current market value to determine reassessment exposure.
- [Property Tax Appeal Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/tax-appeal-appraisals): Property tax appeal appraisals for California assessment appeals and decline-in-value applications. Retrospective lien-date values, hearing testimony available.
- [Bankruptcy Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/bankruptcy-appraisals): Independent bankruptcy appraisals for Chapter 7, 11 and 13 filings in California. Trustee- and court-accepted, fast turnaround available.
- [Expert Witness & Litigation Support](https://www.ward.pro/services/expert-witness): Expert witness appraisal testimony and litigation support in California. Contested valuations, USPAP appraisal review, deposition and trial testimony.
- [Appraisal Review](https://www.ward.pro/services/appraisal-review): USPAP appraisal review in California. Independent critique of an existing appraisal's methodology, data and adjustments for divorce, probate and litigation.
- [Desktop Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/desktop-appraisals): USPAP-compliant desktop appraisals in all 58 California counties, no property visit. From $299. Note: desktop does not meet IRS requirements for improved residential property.
- [Rental & Income Analysis](https://www.ward.pro/services/rental-income-analysis): Market rent and income analysis for California 2-4 unit residential property. Rental surveys, income approach, family-law and estate support.
- [Pre-Purchase Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/pre-purchase-appraisals): Independent pre-purchase appraisals in California for buyers, including cash buyers and unusual properties. Not a lender appraisal.
- [Pre-Sale Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/pre-sale-appraisals): Pre-sale appraisals for California sellers. Independent pre-listing valuation, estate and trust sale support, improvement-return guidance.
- [PMI Removal Appraisals](https://www.ward.pro/services/pmi-removal-appraisals): PMI removal appraisals in California. Current valuations supporting cancellation of private mortgage insurance after appreciation or renovation.
